tests.title: Version scoped prompt releases and copies
tests.developer_story_extension: As the attorney, I need prompt authorship, audience and revision history separated from each execution.
tests.scenario_and_expected_result: Create synthetic personal, firm and vendor prompts. Duplicate a vendor prompt, edit the copy and reorder two actions; retain source revision and creator without modifying the original. A change from private to firm/published requires explicit authorized approval and a preview of audience/data. Do not infer that public means open Internet from the guide label. Revoke access then search/run through both prompt and TemplateLab routes: denied prompts remain inaccessible. Existing runs pin their approved revision; deleting a reusable prompt does not erase run evidence.

tests.title: Validate typed prerequisites before prompt execution
tests.developer_story_extension: As the attorney, I need structured missing facts gathered without treating contextual answers as exact inserted text.
tests.scenario_and_expected_result: Build a synthetic form with required short/long text, date, single select, multiple choice and document upload. Reject missing required values, ambiguous date years and denied/corrupt files before run. Version answers and distinguish a context-only priority from a literal amount/date/name variable. Insert exact approved values at their mapped locations and test conditional sections; do not let model paraphrase protected variables. Changing matter invalidates stale answers/file access. Preserve I/me/my and four-digit years in every attorney-letter date; unknown years are flagged, not guessed.

tests.title: Extract discovery questions before drafting answers
tests.developer_story_extension: As the attorney, I need exact question text and numbering reviewed before any matter-grounded draft response.
tests.scenario_and_expected_result: Use a synthetic PDF with numbered subparts, page breaks, a repeated heading and one unreadable scan region. Produce an editable question list with page/span provenance; preserve verbatim text where legible, flag uncertainty and do not silently omit/reorder subparts. Approve the extracted set before generating draft answers from the selected matter snapshot. Missing facts remain unresolved rather than invented. Regeneration preserves approved question identities and objections; no answer is served or certified automatically.

tests.title: Separate negotiation chronology from client authority and sending
tests.developer_story_extension: As the attorney, I need every offer/demand tied to its actual source while a client-update draft remains separate from authority to settle.
tests.scenario_and_expected_result: Seed three synthetic offers, one revoked offer, conflicting dates and a client instruction limiting authority. Produce a source-linked table with sender, amount, date/year, status and uncertainty. Draft a counteroffer-update letter in I/me/my voice with four-digit dates; never turn an opposing offer into client acceptance or send the draft. Late source correction invalidates the draft/review snapshot. Duplicate messages do not duplicate offers, and an unsourced amount cannot become an established negotiation fact.

tests.title: Bound a medical narrative by the selected record set
tests.developer_story_extension: As the attorney, I need a medical chronology that identifies omitted records and conflicting evidence instead of presenting a selected-page summary as the complete medical history.
tests.scenario_and_expected_result: Use synthetic progress, operative and imaging reports with overlapping visits, illegible text and a contradicted date. Preserve record/page citations and chronology, flag gaps/contradictions and separate reported diagnosis from an AI inference. Show precisely which pages were selected, not a claim of full ingestion. If size/context limits are unknown or exceeded, pause with a measurable gap rather than silently truncating. A suggested large-record integration requires its own verified entitlement/provider/data path. Demand/complaint drafting needs separate attorney approval.

tests.title: Keep prompt test mode separate from saved matter outputs
tests.developer_story_extension: As the attorney, I need a test run clearly labeled, with data processing and persistent outputs separately evidenced.
tests.scenario_and_expected_result: Run only synthetic input against two matter fixtures. Record prompt/schema/source snapshot and output status without claiming a saved document or approved template. Closing a non-saving test cannot create a finalized letter, billed activity, task completion or external message. Test-mode absence from the matter list does not prove absence from provider logs; disclose unknown processing/retention and require verified policy before client data use. Switching test matter clears stale private context and rechecks file permissions.

tests.title: Preserve approval and unresolved matches before billing export
tests.developer_story_extension: As the attorney, I need one master review ledger with uncertain matter matches visible and billing export gated by approval.
tests.scenario_and_expected_result: Combine synthetic Timing, individual call/text, email and drafting events; retain provider IDs, raw intervals and unresolved matter selections. Hold/unreviewed rows never export to a synthetic CosmoLex adapter. Approving a mapped row records actor/version and creates one idempotent export request; repeated updates or alternate CSV route cannot duplicate a timecard. A source synchronization flag or exported filename does not prove provider ingestion. Reconcile all required daily source windows and corrections before calling a review complete. Archived proposals are historical context, not evidence a connector currently works.
